subject: Nimbus POC — access, credentials, and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>, Sally Chen <sally.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Nimbus POC — post-call recap and access requests

Thanks for the call earlier — great alignment on what the POC should prove out. Quick recap and next steps so we can get the trial environment configured this week.

High-level success criteria (from our call):
- End-to-end inference run on a realistic batch of 10k queries with median latency < 300ms and 99th < 1s
- Cost per 1k tokens below target you shared (TBD in follow-up)
- Acceptable output quality on the evaluation set (you to share)

What we need from Nimbus to provision the staging tenant:
1) SSO: IdP type and SAML metadata or email addresses to invite (SAML preferred)
2) IP allowlist: list of public egress IPs that need access to the staging service
3) Primary point-of-contact for ops (for network/infra coordination)
4) Any files for data handling/compliance we should be aware of

I attached a short POC scope doc with timelines and ownership — please review and confirm. Proposed timeline:
- Provisioning and credentials: 1-2 business days after we receive SSO/allowlist
- POC execution & evaluation: 2 weeks
- Review & decision: demo + results presentation week of Mar 9

Next steps / owners:
- Nimbus: send SSO metadata and allowlist + evaluation dataset (Alex)
- Redwood: create staging tenant, generate API key, confirm allowlist and send SSO invite (Marissa / Rishi)

Attachments: [Attachment: Nimbus_POC_Scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally to get the provisioning request started once we have the allowlist/SSO details.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

- Stability at 10k requests over a 24h window with <1% error rate
- Latency and cost targets aligned with Marissa’s bullets
- Integration with our SSO (SAML) and logs forwarded to our SIEM during the test

Access details:
- SSO: SAML IdP. I attached our SAML metadata. If you need a separate test SP, please create and share the ACS URL.
- Allowlist IPs (egress to Redwood staging): 34.201.12.5, 34.201.12.6, 18.204.33.11
- Ops contact: ops@nimbushealth.com (note: <> on calendar is Michael Park, infra lead)

We’ll upload the evaluation prompt set to the shared Drive link after we finalize the NDA (linked in HubSpot).

Subject: Fwd: Nimbus POC — post-call recap and access requests / please provision staging tenant

Forwarding Alex’s details — please action provisioning tasks so we can meet the proposed timeline. Summary of asks for infra/SRE:
- Create a staging tenant named: nimbus-staging (region: us-west-2)
- Generate a scoped API key for eval team (read/write inference) and store in 1Password; do NOT paste key in email
- Add allowlist entries: 34.201.12.5, 34.201.12.6, 18.204.33.11
- Prepare SAML SP metadata / ACS URL and send SSO invite to Sally and Alex once SP is configured
- Enable log forwarding to their SIEM endpoint (we’ll coordinate endpoint with ops@nimbushealth.com)

Deadline: please have tenant + API key + allowlist confirmed by end of day tomorrow (Fri 20 Feb). Rishi — can you take point on SSO? Vivek — can you own tenant creation and key generation?

Happy to jump on a quick screen-share if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
